comment_regular: Throttled Oblivion sky reflection-cube refresh, called only from ShadowPass. For interiors it temporarily forces sky mode 2, refreshes colors/fog, updates atmosphere/clouds, hides moons, substitutes the sky vector, renders the sky root through ShadowSceneNode mode 3, then restores every altered state.
